game: Dealer's Choice / Lucky Ace / High Ace

sections.Profile:
Williams built this card and gambling playfield, designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche, in three electro-mechanical versions with four flippers: Dealer's Choice , a four-player game it began building in December 1973 and made 8,850 of; Lucky Ace , the one-player version released in November 1974, of which 2,809 were built; and High Ace , which Williams cancelled at 30 units.
